faq.question: Is Kongu Engineering College a university?
faq.answer: It is a private autonomous college affiliated to Anna University, Chennai. Anna University lists its examination code as 7378 and TNEA counselling code as 2711; autonomous status does not turn the college into a separate university.

faq.question: How do I apply for undergraduate engineering?
faq.answer: The documented government-quota route is TNEA counselling. Register under the current brochure, complete certificate verification and choose Kongu Engineering College, code 2711, with the correct branch; management-quota entry is a separate documented route.

faq.question: What Class 12 subjects and marks are needed?
faq.answer: The engineering regulations require HSC or an accepted equivalent with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry. TNEA 2026 used a 45% average in these subjects for General Category and 40% for specified reserved categories, along with nativity and schooling rules.

faq.question: Are the programmes taught in English?
faq.answer: The applicable B.E./B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MBA and MCA regulations specify English for instruction, examinations and project reports. This language rule is separate from whether an overseas qualification or admission category is accepted.

faq.question: What tuition should I budget for the next intake?

faq.question: What does hostel accommodation cost?

faq.question: When does the academic intake take place?

faq.question: Can international applicants use this admission route?

faq.question: How is the MBA organised?
faq.answer: The MBA is a two-year programme organised into six trimesters. Its regulations include functional and sectoral electives, skill enhancement, a summer internship and a capstone project.

faq.question: Can a graduate without a computing background join MCA?
faq.answer: The degree must first be accepted for admission under Anna University and Directorate of Technical Education conditions. Students without a computing-equivalent background must complete four additional non-credit bridge courses during the first two semesters.

faq.question: Does autonomous status mean every programme has NBA accreditation?
faq.answer: No. UGC autonomy and Anna University affiliation are institutional statuses, while NBA accreditation is programme-specific and time-limited. Check the exact programme and validity period instead of assuming one accreditation covers every degree.

universities.summary: Periyar Maniammai Institute of Science & Technology (PMIST) is a private deemed-to-be university at Vallam, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu. Its regular degree portfolio spans engineering, computing, management, architecture, science and humanities. Engineering, MBA and MCA entry routes combine programme-specific academic requirements with merit or entrance selection.
universities.campusLifestyle: The Vallam campus covers 114.85 acres. Students can use sports facilities and participate in the National Sports Organization’s physical-fitness, martial-arts, games and sports activities. Periyar Maniammai Hospital operates inside the campus.
universities.cityProfile: PMIST is at Periyar Nagar, Vallam, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu 613403. Its teaching campus is distinct from Periyar University in Salem and from Ponnaiyah Ramajayam Institute of Science & Technology (PRIST), another Thanjavur institution. The university’s online registration route serves applicants to the Vallam campus.
universities.practicalExposure: The postgraduate regulations provide credit-bearing industrial training or internships in two-week slots: two weeks earn one credit, four weeks two credits and six weeks three credits. A continuous placement within one organization and a submitted report form part of the assessment. Up to six weeks of summer industrial training can replace one professional elective under the specified approval process. The Centre for University Industry Interaction coordinates placement, training and university-industry activity.
universities.hostelOverview: Campus accommodation includes Chakravarthy boys’ hostel and Annai Maniammaiyar and Vittobai girls’ hostels. Published accommodation charges include room rent, mess, electricity and maintenance, washing and deposits. The available fee PDF is undated, so obtain the current room allocation and total payable amount before budgeting.
universities.dietarySupport: Hostel mess charges are listed separately from room rent and include meals within the accommodation fee structure. The available schedule does not establish current menus or special-diet provision; discuss dietary requirements before choosing accommodation.
universities.safetyOverview: The campus has an Anti-Ragging Cell, an Internal Complaints Committee and a student grievance process. The on-campus hospital operates 24 hours with a medical officer and paramedical support.
universities.studentSupport: The Centre for Student Administrative Services handles student grievances, including admission, fee-refund and accommodation concerns. An International Academic Advisor supports international students with programme and campus information. Students Traffic can help review programme fit and application readiness.

faq.question: Is PMIST private or government?
faq.answer: PMIST is a private deemed-to-be university. The UGC register records its deemed status from 17 August 2007 and locates it at Vallam, Thanjavur.

faq.question: Is PMIST the same as Periyar University?
faq.answer: No. PMIST is at Vallam in Thanjavur. Periyar University is a separate state university in Salem, while PRIST is another distinct institution in Thanjavur.

faq.question: What is the teaching language?
faq.answer: The regular B.Tech regulations specify English. The 2024 postgraduate regulations use English instruction and permit bilingual English/Tamil examinations; MA Tamil follows a separate Tamil-medium rule.

faq.question: Can international applicants apply?
faq.answer: The 2026-27 approval identifies international access programme by programme. Some programmes have international approval while others do not; a university-wide international policy should not be used to assume access to every degree.

faq.question: What subjects are needed for B.Tech?
faq.answer: Aerospace, Civil and Mechanical Engineering require Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. Biotechnology requires Physics and Chemistry with Biology, Biotechnology or Mathematics; CSE, ECE and EEE require Physics and Mathematics plus an approved additional subject.

faq.question: What is the MBA entry requirement?
faq.answer: Applicants need a bachelor’s degree of at least three years with 50% marks, or 45% for a reserved category. A qualifying PMIST, TANCET, MAT, CAT or equivalent entrance result is required for the dual-specialisation MBA.

faq.question: How do students apply?
faq.answer: Use PMIST’s online registration page and select the intended programme. Complete the academic details, follow the relevant merit or entrance route and present the required qualification and admission-category records.

faq.question: When does the academic year begin?
faq.answer: The signed schedule gives 22 July 2026 as commencement for 2026-27. That date describes the verified academic cycle; it is not an application deadline or a confirmed future intake date.

faq.question: How much should students budget?
faq.answer: Request a current, category-specific quotation covering tuition, compulsory charges, accommodation and meals. The public programme-fee table gives total first-year charges without a clear academic year or tuition-only breakdown, so it is not used as a confirmed tuition price.

faq.question: Does PMIST have hostels?
faq.answer: Chakravarthy boys’ hostel and the girls’ hostels provide campus accommodation. Charges include room rent, mess and other service components; confirm current availability, deposits and fees before accepting a room.

faq.question: Is practical training part of postgraduate study?
faq.answer: The postgraduate regulations provide credit for industrial training and internships in two-week slots. Students complete continuous training in an organization, submit a report and follow departmental evaluation and approval requirements.

faq.question: Is Bharathiar University public?
faq.answer: Bharathiar University is a state public university established by the Government of Tamil Nadu in February 1982. The published programme set here concerns its Coimbatore university departments; affiliated-college and distance-learning routes have separate admissions.

faq.question: What is the teaching language?
faq.answer: The regular postgraduate CBCS rules use English for instruction, examinations, seminars and project work, except Tamil-language curricula. The programmes published here use that English-medium route; language requirements must still match the selected degree.

faq.question: Can I apply after Class 12?
faq.answer: The postgraduate courses here require a qualifying undergraduate degree. The university also lists separate B.Voc. and blended B.Sc. routes for school-leavers, whose entry rules and application schedules must be checked individually.

faq.question: How much is international postgraduate tuition?
faq.answer: The 2026-27 international fee schedule lists USD750 tuition per annum, USD50 admission and USD100 examination fee. Accommodation, food and other charges are separate. The one-year Career Guidance lateral-entry route requires a specific fee quotation.

faq.question: How do I apply?
faq.answer: Register separately for the selected programme at the university online admissions portal. The standard registration fee is INR400; eligible SC/ST applicants pay INR200 with community evidence. Complete programme-specific selection and document verification.

faq.question: Do all programmes have the same entrance test?
faq.answer: No. The prospectus separates merit-based and university entrance routes. MBA uses TANCET qualification and TNMBA counselling, while MCA uses TANCET or a vacancy-based university entrance test. Medical Biotechnology divides the published seats between GAT-B and the university test.

faq.question: When does the regular PG semester start?
faq.answer: The official CBCS regulations identify July as the start of the odd semester; university departments reopened on 1 July 2025. Later admissions extensions may differ by programme. Check the next application cycle rather than treating this historical timing as current availability.

faq.question: Can international applicants apply?
faq.answer: The Centre for International Affairs handles foreign-student admissions and receives applications through Study in India and ICCR. Applicants must establish degree equivalence, academic eligibility and their programme-specific entrance treatment; no universal exemption is promised.

faq.question: What does the UGC listing mean?
faq.answer: The university appears in the UGC consolidated state-university register dated January 2023 and its Section 12(B) state-university list dated September 2015. These are institutional statuses; they do not guarantee overseas professional registration or recognition for every career.

faq.question: What accommodation and dining are available?
faq.answer: University hostels include an International Hostel. The 2026-27 foreign/NRI schedule lists USD1,210 annual accommodation, electricity and admission charges plus USD200 refundable caution deposit. Food is separately billed, with Indian mess and self-cooking options.

faq.question: What support can students use?
faq.answer: Free personal, psychological and academic counselling is available through the Bharathiar Counselling Centre. Accessible learning support is provided through the Multimodal Material Preparation Centre. Students Traffic can help shortlist an appropriate programme and organise application preparation.

universities.summary: Bharathidasan University is a public state university established in 1982 in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu. Its Palkalaiperur and Khajamalai campuses teach postgraduate and integrated degrees across science, engineering, management, social sciences, humanities and education, alongside vocational and specialist study.
universities.campusLifestyle: Palkalaiperur houses the central library, sports complex, bank, post office, canteen and health centre. Khajamalai hosts selected departments and entrepreneurship activities. Library services include INFLIBNET, DELNET, electronic resources and a 24-hour Garden Library; sports facilities include an indoor stadium, gymnasium, yoga centre and 400-metre athletics track.
universities.cityProfile: Bharathidasan University is based in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu. Its Palkalaiperur main campus is on the Tiruchirappalli–Pudukkottai–Rameswaram highway; a second campus is at Khajamalai in the city. Department and accommodation allocation matter when planning the daily journey between university facilities.
universities.practicalExposure: The Financial Management MBA includes at least four weeks of institutional training after semester two and a final-semester project. Its Centre for Financial Markets works in association with NSE Academy Limited, with finance-firm case analysis and project reports built into the curriculum. Integrated M.Tech students share a first-year curriculum before their academic work is administered by the relevant specialist department. The university also operates a Placement and Training Cell that organises job fairs.
universities.hostelOverview: Hostels are located at Palkalaiperur and Khajamalai, including separate accommodation for men, women and research scholars. Eligibility is limited to students residing at least 40 kilometres from the university. Facilities include Wi-Fi, kitchens and dining rooms, water supply, reading rooms and recreation areas. Current room and mess charges need a hostel quotation before budgeting.
universities.dietarySupport: University hostels have kitchens and dining facilities, and the Palkalaiperur campus has a canteen. Discuss required meals and any dietary restrictions with the hostel before taking a place; current mess charges need a separate accommodation quotation.
universities.safetyOverview: An Anti-Ragging Cell addresses ragging, while the anti-sexual-harassment committee and Students Affairs Cell handle related complaints and grievances. The main campus includes a health centre. These are named campus services, rather than a guarantee about personal safety.
universities.studentSupport: The International Students Cell handles overseas admission categories and qualification assessment. The Centre for Differently Abled Persons supports disability-specific study routes, and the university runs student-affairs and grievance services. Students Traffic can help match qualifications, programme requirements and the appropriate application route.

faq.question: Is Bharathidasan University a public university?
faq.answer: Bharathidasan University is a Tamil Nadu state university established in 1982. The UGC consolidated register lists it at Palkalaiperur, Tiruchirappalli; its university departments are separate from the colleges affiliated to it.

faq.question: Which campus will I study at?
faq.answer: The university operates its main Palkalaiperur campus and the Khajamalai city campus. Palkalaiperur contains the central library, sports complex, health centre and administrative buildings; department and hostel allocation determine your daily campus.

faq.question: Are the programmes taught in English?
faq.answer: The Financial Management MBA regulations specify English. The integrated M.Tech programmes have English and Tamil options; the offerings shown here cover English medium only. Confirm the English class allocation with the department when accepting an integrated-programme place.

faq.question: Can I enter an integrated M.Tech after school?
faq.answer: The six-year integrated programmes admit after Plus Two or equivalent, with subjects specified separately for Biotechnology, Computer Science and Engineering, and Geological Technology and Geoinformatics. The university describes entrance-based selection for integrated programmes; this is a longer route than a two-year postgraduate M.Tech after a prior degree.

faq.question: What does the Financial Management MBA require?
faq.answer: For 2026-27, eligible qualifications include B.Com., B.B.A., Corporate Secretaryship, Bank Management and related Commerce degrees, with an Accountancy course and at least 50% under Part III. Selection gives equal weight to Part III marks and the entrance test. Valid scores in the tests named in the prospectus allow entrance-test exemption.

faq.question: How much is tuition for Indian students?
faq.answer: The 2026-27 tuition for the Financial Management MBA and the integrated M.Tech options shown here is INR 20,000 per semester. Two semesters therefore carry INR 40,000 tuition, with laboratory and university charges where applicable. Admission totals vary by programme and prior board or university; accommodation is additional.

faq.question: Do foreign students pay the same amount?
faq.answer: Foreign-student tuition follows a separate USD policy, with different treatment for developed and other countries. Its outside-India qualification column also includes recognition charges. Obtain an individual international fee assessment rather than treating an Indian-student admission total as your foreign-national tuition.

faq.question: How do I apply to a university department?
faq.answer: Use the regular University Departments admissions portal and select the exact programme. The general MBA, Logistics and Supply Chain Management MBA, and International Business MBA use Tamil Nadu MBA/MCA counselling instead; Financial Management has its own department selection rules. Students Traffic can help identify the route for your qualification.

faq.question: When does the academic year begin?
faq.answer: Applications usually open around May and June, followed by classes in July. That is a usual annual pattern. The next admission cycle needs its own notification before an application deadline or reporting date can be relied on.

faq.question: Can international and NRI students apply?
faq.answer: The International Students Cell covers foreign passport holders, NRIs educated abroad and qualifying NRI-sponsored students. It describes postgraduate and integrated programmes and assesses overseas qualifications. Category-specific admission, fees and document requirements need confirmation for the intended programme.

faq.question: Is hostel accommodation available?
faq.answer: Hostels operate across Palkalaiperur and Khajamalai, with separate accommodation for men and women and dedicated research-scholar hostels. Hostel eligibility is limited to students living at least 40 kilometres away. Rooms have Wi-Fi, dining facilities and reading or recreation spaces; a current accommodation quotation is needed.

faq.question: Does the MBA include practical training?
faq.answer: The Financial Management MBA requires at least four weeks of institutional training after semester two and a final-semester project. The regulations describe work in finance firms and a Centre for Financial Markets associated with NSE Academy Limited. These are curriculum features and do not promise employment or a particular salary.

The postgraduate regulations provide credit-bearing industrial training or internships in two-week slots: two weeks earn one credit, four weeks two credits and six weeks three credits. A continuous placement within one organization and a submitted report form part of the assessment. Up to six weeks of summer industrial training can replace one professional elective under the specified approval process. The Centre for University Industry Interaction coordinates placement, training and university-industry activity.

Bharathiar University is a public university in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, established in 1982. Its university departments offer postgraduate study across sciences, computing, commerce, management, humanities and social sciences, with a separate Centre for International Affairs supporting overseas admissions.

The university campus lies at the foothills of Maruthamalai, about 12 km from Coimbatore city. Teaching and research schools, the library, administrative offices and hostels share a campus of about 1,000 acres. The library opens 8 am–8 pm on working days and 10 am–4.30 pm on weekends.

Coimbatore is the university’s city location in Tamil Nadu. The campus is at the foothills of Maruthamalai, about 12 km from the city, so students choosing private accommodation should plan the journey to their department. University hostels offer an on-campus alternative, subject to allocation.

Postgraduate programmes use core, elective and supportive papers under the Choice Based Credit System. The regular two-year PG structure includes a fourth-semester project, with some programmes including internship, field trips or industrial visits. MBA follows a separate credit structure. Laboratory, project and field requirements depend on the exact programme.

University hostels and an International Hostel are available. The 2026-27 international schedule lists annual accommodation of USD1,000, electricity of USD200 and admission of USD10, plus a refundable USD200 caution deposit. Food is separate and room allocation must be confirmed.

International Hostel residents can use the Indian mess at the monthly charges applied to Indian students. Special dining is charged at actual expense, and self-cooking facilities are available in the International Hostel.

The University Hospital provides a doctor and staff nurse from 9 am to 6 pm on working days. The university also lists a 24-hour campus ambulance service. These services do not replace personal health-insurance planning.

The Bharathiar Counselling Centre offers free support for personal, psychological and academic concerns. The Multimodal Material Preparation Centre provides assistive technology and accessible learning resources. Students Traffic can help assess programme fit and plan the application.

Established February 1982. Palkalaiperur main campus and Khajamalai city campus; university departments teach across sciences, management, humanities, engineering and education.

Palkalaiperur houses the central library, sports complex, bank, post office, canteen and health centre. Khajamalai hosts selected departments and entrepreneurship activities. Library services include INFLIBNET, DELNET, electronic resources and a 24-hour Garden Library; sports facilities include an indoor stadium, gymnasium, yoga centre and 400-metre athletics track.

Hostels are located at Palkalaiperur and Khajamalai, including separate accommodation for men, women and research scholars. Eligibility is limited to students residing at least 40 kilometres from the university. Facilities include Wi-Fi, kitchens and dining rooms, water supply, reading rooms and recreation areas. Current room and mess charges need a hostel quotation before budgeting. University hostels have kitchens and dining facilities, and the Palkalaiperur campus has a canteen. Discuss required meals and any dietary restrictions with the hostel before taking a place; current mess charges need a separate accommodation quotation.

The International Students Cell handles overseas admission categories and qualification assessment. The Centre for Differently Abled Persons supports disability-specific study routes, and the university runs student-affairs and grievance services. Students Traffic can help match qualifications, programme requirements and the appropriate application route.

An Anti-Ragging Cell addresses ragging, while the anti-sexual-harassment committee and Students Affairs Cell handle related complaints and grievances. The main campus includes a health centre. These are named campus services, rather than a guarantee about personal safety.

The Financial Management MBA includes at least four weeks of institutional training after semester two and a final-semester project. Its Centre for Financial Markets works in association with NSE Academy Limited, with finance-firm case analysis and project reports built into the curriculum. Integrated M.Tech students share a first-year curriculum before their academic work is administered by the relevant specialist department. The university also operates a Placement and Training Cell that organises job fairs.
